setup: Sit on the machine seat with your upper back resting firmly against the padded backrest.
Fasten the padded belt or lower the lap bar securely across your hip crease, ensuring it is snug and centered.
Place your feet flat on the footplate roughly shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward so your shins will be roughly vertical at full extension.
steps: Drive through your heels and extend your hips upward to lift the load off the safety stops.
Disengage the machine's safety release lever while holding full hip extension.
Lower your hips under control by flexing at the hips until you achieve a deep stretch in the glutes, keeping your ribcage down and chin tucked.
Drive through the feet and thrust upward until your hips are fully extended and your thighs are in line with your torso.
Pause for a brief second at the top, squeezing your glutes firmly before beginning the next repetition.
At the end of the set, re-engage the safety mechanism at lockout and carefully lower the weight onto the stops.
instructions.breathing: Inhale as you lower your hips, and exhale forcefully as you drive up into full hip extension.
cues: Drive through the midfoot and heel.
Keep your chin tucked and ribs down.
Lock out with your glutes, not your lower back.

common_faults.fault: Hyperextending the lumbar spine at the top of the movement.
common_faults.correction: Focus on posterior pelvic tilt at lockout; squeeze the glutes and keep the ribcage pinned down without overarching the lower back.

common_faults.fault: Feet placed too far forward or too close to the body.
common_faults.correction: Adjust foot placement so your knees form approximately a 90-degree angle when your hips reach full lockout.

common_faults.fault: Knees caving inward during the upward thrust.
common_faults.correction: Actively track your knees in line with your toes throughout the entire range of motion.

precautions: Ensure the safety lock mechanism is fully functional and practice engaging it before loading heavy weights.
Fasten the strap tightly across the pelvic crease, avoiding direct pressure on the soft abdomen.

name: Machine Hip Thrust
summary: A machine-guided hip extension exercise performed against a padded belt or lap bar to target the glutes with stable spinal support.
